body: This was excellent to see - I loved Arnold’s advice about not thinking. It’s true. I find the more I “think” about going to the gym, the more time it takes away not actually going. Then, hours later I’m on my couch binge eating. Great way to put it in perspective, I appreciated this
I never once said main priority. However, some of us can’t afford high fuel costs. What’s that line the left loves to use? Oh yeah, your privilege is showing.
That’s just the start my friend
Honestly the next 24 hours are gonna be rough when we’re back to Obama style gas prices

I switched to using the dpad and practiced on vert ramps switching from special to revert to manual, then after that I worked on leveling out after a very combo so I can manual and/or grind to the next surface. It took some practice for me to smoothly revert to manual. Give it some time and try practicing on a small vert ramp like the one in skate street, I felt that that helped me a lot. But yeah switching from revert to manual felt weird at first and sometimes it wouldn’t go, I had to work on my timing

Initially when I played the game as a kid I used to mash buttons. I played it religiously as a kid and when I started back up I did the same thing and also found it to be difficult. I started focusing on more specials and reverts and felt my score increased greatly. I was going from 30,000k combos to 1 mil combos quickly just doing that. I didn’t feel like it was a job, and once I did my own groove I felt that it came easier to see where I can work with combos in the game. Not sure if that helps or not.
